canonical_name: Mapi Pharma – GA Depot (glatiramer acetate depot)

current_status.stage: US: FDA issued a Complete Response Letter for the RMS indication NDA in March 2024; no confirmed resubmission reported yet. EU: reported (single-source, unverified) to be under regulatory review in Germany for RMS, with potential EU launch targeted 2027. Phase III PPMS study initiation planned for 2026 following Israeli Ministry of Health GMP approval of Mapi's manufacturing facility.
current_status.partner: Viatris (exclusive license to commercialize GA Depot for relapsing forms of MS, RMS)
current_status.data_point: AAN 2026 (Apr): Phase 3 RMS EDSS stable 2.6->2.5 at 1 year, 96.4% of GA Depot patients had no EDSS increase vs 91.6% on placebo (n=1,016); Phase 2a PPMS EDSS stable 5.1->4.9 over ~3 years (n=30)

finding_history.summary: FDA issued a Complete Response Letter for the GA Depot 40mg NDA (relapsing forms of MS indication); reason not publicly disclosed. Viatris and Mapi Pharma stated they were committed to addressing FDA's concerns and intended to resubmit. This followed positive Phase 3 topline data (30.1% ARR reduction vs placebo, p=0.0066, n=1,016) announced in Sept 2022.

Mapi Pharma announced it would present new safety/efficacy data from its Phase II open-label PPMS study of GA Depot at ACTRIMS Forum 2026 (Feb 5-7, San Diego). The announcement also stated Mapi had recently received Israeli Ministry of Health GMP approval (mutually recognized by the EU), enabling initiation of a Phase III PPMS study in 2026 and potential RMS commercial launch (if approved) in 2027; this GMP/timeline claim has only a single Tier-2 source so far.
Mapi Pharma announced a virtual KOL event (held March 3, 2026) to discuss GA Depot once-a-month dosing for primary progressive MS (PPMS).

At AAN 2026, Mapi Pharma presented pooled EDSS-stability analyses: in the Phase 3 RMS trial (n=1,016), mean EDSS was essentially unchanged from 2.6 at baseline to 2.5 at one year, with 96.4% of GA Depot patients showing no EDSS increase vs. 91.6% on placebo; in the Phase 2a open-label PPMS trial (n=30), EDSS was stable from 5.1 at baseline to 4.9 at ~3 years of follow-up (including similar stability among early discontinuers). Company press release confirmed the same presentations.

Conference-recap coverage of the AAN 2026 presentation reported that GA Depot is under regulatory review in Germany for the relapsing MS indication, with a potential EU commercial launch targeted for 2027, and that a global Phase 3 PPMS study is being planned. This claim has only one Tier-2 source and was not corroborated by a Mapi Pharma or EMA/BfArM primary source.
